summary: Verified Stripe VAT/IVA (23%) integration. Backend: 5/5 pytest passing - GET /api/stripe/plans returns vat_included=false & vat_rate=23; POST /api/stripe/create-checkout-session and /api/stripe/create-subscription-session both create Stripe sessions with automatic_tax.enabled=true and billing_address_collection='required' (verified by retrieving the created sessions via Stripe SDK). Invalid subscription lookup_key returns 404. Site inbound endpoint regression check passed. Frontend (Playwright): all 3 Care plan cards (Essencial, Preventivo, Total) render data-testid='plan-{id}-vat-note' with '+ IVA (23%)'; Subscription Modal shows '+ IVA (23%)' next to plan price and note 'O IVA (23%) e calculado automaticamente e adicionado no pagamento seguro pelo Stripe.' via data-testid='subscription-vat-note'; cart checkout page shows 'Total (sem IVA)' label and data-testid='cart-vat-note' with '+ IVA (23%), calculado automaticamente no pagamento seguro pelo Stripe'. PaymentMethodModal (data-testid='payment-vat-note') code verified at App.js:665 - only triggered after full form completion so not exercised in UI test but wiring is correct. Anual toggle not clicked (accessible name mismatch due to nested '-2 meses' badge span) but the VAT note markup is identical for monthly/annual (outside the price conditional at App.js 1538-1725), so verified by code inspection.

issues: Native browser date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) used instead of shadcn calendar - pre-existing, unrelated to VAT feature

critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 2825 lines - exceeds 700 line guideline; consider splitting PaymentMethodModal, cart/checkout page, and Care plans section into separate components/files
PaymentMethodModal's 'payment-vat-note' is only reachable after full-form validation - main agent confirmed manually; acceptable but not automatable without valid PT postal code & scheduling
Backend automatic_tax + billing_address_collection='required' correctly set for both one-off and subscription flows; tax_code 'txcd_20080007' on line items is appropriate for services
